description: This file defines the KpiDecorator class within the OrangeHRM Performance Plugin. It provides methods to enhance or modify Kpi entities, including setting a JobTitle reference by ID. The class uses a trait for ORM helper functions and interacts with external entity classes.

classes.name: KpiDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Kpi entity that provides additional methods for manipulation, including setting related JobTitle entities by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific Kpi entity.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle reference in the Kpi entity by the provided ID.
